items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: Oh, Gilbert, you know what his name? Gilbert. Oh, my God. I can't call him that. That's your cousin.

ctx.x: He played trumpet. And who was in his band and what did they play?
Oh, Gilbert, you know what his name? Gilbert. Oh, my God. I can't call him that. That's your cousin.
What instrument did he play? He played clarinet. He still play clarinet? No, he quit playing.
